sources.entry: Clip’M - Clipboard manager with searchable history, previews, reusable snippets, and paste transformations.

summary.one_liner: clip'M is a clipboard manager for Apple silicon Macs that keeps searchable copy history, previews, reusable snippets, and paste-time text transformations.
summary.what_it_does: The app keeps a history of copied items that you open from a menu with ⌥⌘V. Pressing / starts a search that filters history as you type, and Tab (or an image button) limits results to images only. Hovering a clip or opening a history group shows a live preview of text, screenshots, and documents beside the menu. Snippets let you organize reusable text into folders such as email, phone, addresses, and boilerplate, and open them from the same menu as history. Actions transform a clip before pasting, with built-in options like uppercase, lowercase, and URL decoding, and support for user-programmed actions. The README describes it as a port of the older ClipMenu app to native Apple silicon.
use_cases: find a clipboard item copied days ago
paste several items copied from one document
store reusable email or address snippets
convert text to uppercase or lowercase before pasting
how_to_run: Or download clipM-1.0.6.dmg from the GitHub releases and drag clip'M into Applications
notable: Ported from the original ClipMenu to native Apple silicon
Live previews of text, screenshots, and documents
Snippets organized in folders alongside clipboard history
Paste transformations with built-in and user-programmed actions
caveats: Built for Apple silicon M-series Macs
Mac App Store version requires a manual ⌘V after selecting an item because the App Store restricts Accessibility use; the direct download presses ⌘V automatically
